Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5590; lifeless, i.e. inanimate (mechanical):--without life.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says even lifeless things that give sound, whether pipe or harp, must give a distinction in the sounds, or no one will know what is being played. The word is without life, an instrument with no breath of its own.
TheologicalSignificance: Sound without sense is noise, and worship without sense is no better.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
